source: Be careful not to fall on the icy path.
targets: Bee kiaralagh dy ny huittym er y chassan rioee.
Jean kiarail nagh duittym er y chassan rioee.

source: Did you check if the door was locked?
targets: Ren oo castey my row yn dorrys glassit?
Ren oo kiartaghey my va'n dorrys doont?

source: Every citizen has the right to vote.
targets: Ta kiart dy choo-choyrle ec dagh seyranagh.
Ta kiart ec dagh seyranagh dy votal.
Ta saase ec dagh seyraanagh dy votal.

source: He decided to bare the old wall of its ivy.
targets: Ren eh reaghey dy lhome y shenn-voalley jeh e edd-vuc.
Ren eh reaghey dy lhommey y shenn-voalley jeh e edd-vuc.

source: He pleaded not guilty to all charges.
targets: Ren eh plaiyn neuchyndagh da dagh cassid.
Ren eh pladaiyl nagh va kyndagh rish dagh cassid.

source: He tends to affect an air of superiority.
targets: Ta cliaghtey echey cliaghtaghey aer ard-cheim.
Ta eh cliaghtaghey aer dy ard-chummaght.

source: His sarcastic remarks always antagonize his colleagues.
targets: Ta ny raaghyn sarkastagh echey dy kinjagh cur olk er e cho-obbreeyn.
Ta e raaghyn sarkastagh dy kinjagh cur olk er e cho-obbreeyn.

source: It would appall me to see such injustice.
targets: Jeanagh eh agglaghey mee dy 'akin lheid y neu-chairys.
Hooilley eh agglaghey mee dy 'akin lheid y neu-chiartys.

source: Please close the door quietly.
targets: Jannoo y dorrys dy kiune.
Jeight y dorrys dy kiune, my sailliu.

source: Please enter the building quietly.
targets: Entreil y troggal dy kiune, my sailt.
Entreil yn troggal dy kiune, my sailt.

source: The barber will cut his hair short.
targets: Nee yn baareyder keyllaghey e ghruaig dy ghiare.
Nee yn baareyder baarey e ghruaig dy ghiare.

source: The bird alighted on the branch.
targets: Ren yn eean injillaghey er y vanglane.
Injillaghey yn eean er y vanglane.

source: The complaint was about the resident.
targets: Va'n accan mychione yn 'er-eirinys.
Va'n accan mychione yn moir-chittagh.

source: The complaint was about the subject.
targets: Va'n accan mychione yn chooish.
Va'n accan mychione yn moir-chittagh.

source: The court decided to annul the marriage.
targets: Hug y chooyrt coardailys dy ollaghey yn poosey.
Ren y quaiyl coontey dy follaghey y poosey.

source: The fire will denude the forest.
targets: Lhome-ee yn aile y cheyll.
Lhommey-ee yn aile y cheyll.

source: The sheep were shorn to bare them of their heavy wool.
targets: Va ny kirree beayrtit dy lhommey ad jeh nyn olley tromm.
Va ny kirree beayrtit dy lhome ad jeh nyn olley tromm.

source: The strong winds will bare the trees of their leaves.
targets: Nee ny geayaghyn lajer lhommey ny biljyn jeh nyn nduillagyn.
Nee ny geayaghyn lajer lhome ny biljyn jeh nyn nduillagyn.

source: The tide will ebb in a few hours.
targets: Traih yn roayrt ayns kuse dy ooraghyn.
Traihee yn roayrt ayns kuse veg d'ooryn.

source: They walked through the quiet churchyard.
targets: Ren ad shooyl trooid y cheeill cheayney.
Hooar ad trooid y cheeill.

source: We heard a loud report from the construction site.
targets: Cheayll shin bwoalley ard veih'n voayl troggal.
Cheayll shin polt ard veih'n voayl troggal.

source: We need to amend the document before printing it.
targets: Ta feme ain dy giartaghey yn docamad roish my churmayd magh eh.
Ta feme ain lhiassaghey yn docamad roish my vel eh prentit.

source: We should advocate for peace and understanding.
targets: Lhisagh dooin moylley shee as toiggal.
Lhieggagh dooin mollaghey son shee as toiggal.
